requirements.title: The application shall preserve personal-local capability.
requirements.description: While using personal-local or offline mode, users shall open/edit/import/render/export eligible local projects without website sign-in or full-fleet availability and see precise unavailable reasons for optional services.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-COMMERCE-PERSONAL protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.description: When optional paid services are connected, the adapter shall use canonical identity and selected-account linking, fully verify principal/account/install/resource/audience/link/scopes and expiry, and handle switch/unlink/revocation through owners.
